source.name: chicagofirefc.com – 'Chicago Fire FC Announces Magellan Corporation as Official Jersey Sleeve Sponsor'
source.quote: Magellan branding will be featured on the sleeve of the First Team home and away jerseys

note: Expanded multiyear agreement of 2024-05-03; Magellan had been an Official Partner of the club since December 2023. The 2026 listing (For Soccer, 2026-02-17) still shows Magellan on the right sleeve. No reported deal value.
